description: This Java source file defines the SensorCentral class, which manages sensor values, listeners, and integration with engine state. It implements the ISensorCentral interface and provides methods to get/set sensor values, register listeners, initialize sensor data, and notify on updates.

classes.name: SensorCentral
classes.description: Manages sensor values and listeners, provides sensor data initialization, and supports listener notifications for sensor updates.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of SensorCentral.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value for a specified sensor.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Updates the value of a specified sensor and notifies listeners if the value has changed.

methods.name: addListener
methods.description: Registers a listener to be notified when a specific sensor updates.

methods.name: removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from a specific sensor.

methods.name: setAnySensorListener
methods.description: Sets a listener to be notified when any sensor value is updated.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes sensor values from the engine state.

methods.name: applyValueToTables
methods.description: Internal method to propagate sensor value updates to other components.

methods.name: addDoubleSensor
methods.description: Helper method to register sensors with the engine state and setup callbacks.
